items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the interviewer mentions 'Clemmer is working' and 'Clemmer Turbillons'.

ctx.x: Yeah. I like sort of sentimental music. You like sentimental? More or less, yeah. That's good too. Personal preference. That's good too. But I like the Dixieland style of jazz and so on.

Well you're relatively young to be playing with the bands that play Dixieland, it's surprising you know. There's not too many guys in their forties playing with them. No. Clemmer is working and he took Bill Matthews' place at the paddock. Oh he did? Yeah. And Bill Matthews is out of the paddock. He's been out a couple of weeks now. Oh yeah?
